name: fix85_inventory_drop
verifies: fix-85 item 3 / fix-92 [owner]: the hero drops from the inventory page (G3 CP has none) only by dragging a tile out and letting go over the game world (no key, no text); a release over the HUD sidebar keeps the stack; a stack asks the amount in G3's amount dialog; the items lie flat in front of the hero (fix-75 rest pose), are saved like other world items and can be picked up; quest items are refused with the deny sound; a worn weapon is taken off first
notes: It_1H_Ingvar_Sword carries ItemFlags.Mission (quest item). invdrop lets the dragged tile go at a screen point found on the live UI (G3InventoryScreen.ReleaseDrag: same target search and handler as a mouse release): at=world is a point outside every UI element (IsWorldPoint), at=sidebar the middle of IDC_VIEW_BAR_PAGES_2 (must not drop). The equipped sword is unequipped before it leaves the inventory. fix-96: arrow counts are relative (the hero may start with arrows: r38 had 50 before give Arrow 20).
